Thanks — can you confirm by end of day today?

Hi Priya — thanks for the clear note and the timeline. Quick answers up front and a couple of options so you can pick the path that fits Acme’s audit needs: 

1) Coverage: Our latest completed SOC 2 Type II report is for the period Jan 1, 2025 — Dec 31, 2025. It does not natively cover Jun 1, 2025 — May 31, 2026.

2) Options we can offer (pick one):
   - Option A (recommended): We’ll share the Jan–Dec 2025 Type II report + a signed bridge letter stating that control environment and SLAs remained materially unchanged from Jan 1, 2026 through May 31, 2026, and listing any minor exceptions if present. This is standard practice and accepted by many audit teams.
   - Option B: Provide the Jan–Dec 2025 report + scoped control evidence samples (audit logs, change management excerpts, access reviews) that cover Jan–May 2026 to demonstrate continuity.
   - Option C: If you need full continuous coverage, we can provide a scoped attestation from our security lead and a short evidence bundle, but that is slower.

3) Secure transfer: we can (a) upload a redacted copy to a presigned S3 link (recommended), (b) place files on an SFTP drop, or (c) share via a limited Google Drive folder — whichever your procurement team prefers.

4) Redaction: We redact customer PII and internal ticket IDs by default. We can provide a redaction manifest describing what was removed.

I’m cc’ing Marissa (security) and Ben (legal/contracts) to gather the bundle and prepare the bridge letter template. If you confirm Option A and prefer S3 presign, we’ll aim to have the files to you within 4 business hours.

Quick templates (one-line replies you can send back):

- "Option B; need access to control samples via SFTP."

Thanks — I’ll follow up with the link and the draft bridge letter.
